description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMessageMapper' which implements the 'MessageMapper' interface. It provides common fields and methods for message mappers, including configuration initialization and getter methods for properties such as id, conditions, and content type blocklist.

classes.name: AbstractMessageMapper
classes.description: An abstract implementation of the MessageMapper interface that manages common properties like id, conditions, and content type blocklist, as well as configuration logic.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the mapper.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the incoming message conditions as a map.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the outgoing message conditions as a map.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the collection of blocked content types.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Initializes the mapper's properties based on provided configuration objects.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Hook method for mapper-specific additional configuration, default implementation is a no-op.
